edits.before: Trade autos behind the roar sustain — the cow chips politely until level 2 changes religions.
edits.after: Aqua Prison's bubble and Ebb and Flow poke out-trade your melee range at Level 1.

edits.before: W-Q online — the combo is live and every squishy support is now flash-range nervous.
edits.after: Her bubble can interrupt your W-Q knockup before it starts — she holds Level 2.

edits.before: Full kit: headbutt-pulverize the carry off any wave state; trample the disengage.
edits.after: Her immobility lets your guaranteed W-Q dominate by level 3.

edits.before: Zone with combo threat — their carry farms at the range your W defines.
edits.after: Through 4-5 you walk down her squishy poke and land engages she can't answer.

edits.before: Unbreakable Will online — tower dives become appointments; the cow ignores the counter-CC.
edits.after: Your R dive beats her disengage once Aqua Prison is down at level 6.

edits.before: First item: the front line holds and the combos chain into jungler arrivals.
edits.after: First item, your unconditional CC out-values her skillshot-gated peel.

edits.before: Late Alistar opens and survives: combo the carry, ult the focus, and trample the cleanup.
edits.after: Late, her lack of mobility lets your picks decide fights outright.

edits.before: - Nami Aqua Prison: matchup-defining — The bubble starts every Nami play — sidestep it and her kit is small numbers. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep R Unbreakable Will banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Nami Aqua Prison is 12s at rank 1, down to 8s at rank 5 — sidestep it and her kit is small numbers. - Your Pulverize (Q), 14-10s cooldown, punishes the moment it's down. - Keep Unbreakable Will (R) banked for her Tidal Wave, not a habit.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Step up only once Aqua Prison is on cooldown — an 8-12s window where her whole kit is just Ebb and Flow poke.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Flash-engaging into a banked Tidal Wave — her ult knocks up regardless and buys the whole duo a reset.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mobility-Mercs by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mobility-Mercs by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.

edits.before: Commit on Aqua Prison’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
